title: Three-part names: Unity Catalog and Fabric
objectives: Map Unity Catalog names to Fabric workspaces, lakehouses and schemas
Name the schema so a query never picks up a stray copy

exercises.prompt: The sales schema's orders table is the real one; an old copy named orders sits in the default schema. Return the total amount of the real one, as total.
hints: The starter's orders has no schema, so it finds the default schema's old copy.
Write sales.orders. In Databricks the full name would be catalog.sales.orders.
